notes: Real screenshot of the repo's own index.html (ardev-dev/abdulrahman), served untouched with python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1:8131 and captured with Playwright/Chrome at a 1280x800 viewport (x1.75 -> 2240x1400), because at 1120px the hero heading wraps onto three lines (that variant is kept as alt-1120.png). The hero line is typed by typed.js, so the capture waited in real time until the typing element held the full string 'django development' (one of the two strings in assets/js/script.js). Nothing in the page was edited or injected; Font Awesome icons and the Poppins/Nunito fonts load from their CDNs as the page asks; the particles.js background is the page's own. Doubt for the owner: the page is built on a public portfolio template (its meta keywords/description still name the template author, and one Instagram link in the hero still points to the template author's account) - none of that is visible in the captured frame, which shows only the owner's name, his avatar and his own links.
